name: eval-conductor
description: Stop your AI evals from quietly regressing. Fail-closed release gate for scores you already produce (claude plugin eval, pytest, promptfoo, any JSON) — BLOCKs CI on regression, NaN/missing metrics, stale baselines and edited thresholds, with registry-driven thresholds and measured noise bands. Every PROMOTE/BLOCK emits a tamper-evident, signed, hash-chained eval receipt, and pre-registration lets you seal the bar before a run so a decision can prove it was judged against a bar fixed in advance. One-command /eval-prove turns your existing tests into a signed proof and a pasteable PR badge with zero config. Includes the 27-step evidence-gated build ledger.

receipt_key.title: Eval receipt signing key (optional)
receipt_key.description: Hex HMAC key used to sign eval receipts. Leave empty and /eval-init generates one for you, stored gitignored at evals/.receipt-key. Set it here only to reuse a specific key (e.g. to match a CI secret). In CI, supply it as the EVAL_RECEIPT_KEY secret instead.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Only used by /conductor --verify-evidence to confirm one of your own CI runs via the GitHub API; anonymous access works for public repos. In CI, the Actions-provided GITHUB_TOKEN is used automatically.
